column3: Setup: Ensure that an article with references is in DOAJ, e.g. by uploading the test resource file "with_references.xml" as a publisher

Go to admin journal and articles search, find the article "References!" and click "Edit this article"

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/3985_references_article_metadata/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/DOAJ/with_references.xml

column4: The field is a multi-line textarea, with the help text "One reference per line"
The 4 references of the article are shown, one per line, in the order they were uploaded

column3: Add a new reference on a new line, change the text of the first reference, and delete the last reference

column4: Green banner saying "Article created/updated" is shown at the top of the page.
The "References" field shows your changes - the edited first reference, the new reference and no deleted reference
The "References" section shows the same references, in the same order, as the form

column3: Go back to the article metadata form, clear the "References" field completely and click "Update Article"

column4: No "References" section is shown on the page
